resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 1914; a December 13, 1912 press item already describes Martis lookout and its telephone. The story keeps the Register's date and reports the earlier mention without settling it.

notes_for_editor: NHLR is the main source. The Forest Lookouts page is a set of press clippings read as data. Build year is unresolved (1914 NHLR vs a 1912 clipping). No read source dates the deactivation, vandalism or restoration beyond the NHLR sentence; a search summary claimed a 1997 restoration from one source, which was not verified and is not used. A 1939 clipping names 'Waddles Maher', probably a typo, so it is not used. The 1935 clipping places Maher among rangers from the station, not as lookout, so the story says he was placed at the station. Public access to the cab is not established. Record fields match NHLR: Placer County, elevation 2,626 m, registered 1998 (US 277, CA 12 confirmed on the register page). No photos added.
